correction: Earlier classification of ENTRY_D.RES as DOS MZ executable was incorrect. The first bytes are proprietary resource/image data, not an MZ signature.

verified_observations.subsequent_record_pattern: At subsequent record starts, the first two DWORDs precede width/height/planes/bits/bpp/compression fields; record boundary is consistent with second DWORD + 4 bytes for the observed records.
verified_observations.payload_observation: Indexed 8-bit image-like data follows the header fields; no GIF/AZF magic is required.

texture_count_correlation: 34 image-like records in ENTRY_D.RES versus 29 unique texture refs in ENTRY_D.XAF; therefore resource bundle includes more records than direct room material refs.
next_re: determine semantics of leading DWORD and second DWORD; map each RES record to XAF texture refs using R.EXE loader behavior; identify palette/pixel payload boundaries and decode one record losslessly.
